subtitle: A juicy beef burger with dressed side salad instead of chips, for diners who want a meaty weekday lunch.

taste:
This is a juicy, savoury beef burger with a soft bun and crisp salad rather than chips. The patty brings the richness, while lettuce, fresh tomato and red onion sit inside the bun. That combination keeps the beef at the centre of the meal while providing a mix of soft and crisp textures.

The side salad is the main departure from the classic version: it comes with a light vinaigrette whose tanginess contrasts with the beef. Expect a meaty lunch with freshness on the side, not a smaller patty or a potato accompaniment.

Calorie information for the {name} is not verified in our data, so check Wetherspoon's [nutrition information](/nutrition-information) before relying on a total. The salad replaces chips, but that swap alone does not establish how this meal compares nutritionally with other burgers.

Its beef patty, bun and vinaigrette all need to be considered in the meal total. Extra sides, sauces or a drink can change that total, so check the information for everything you order. The word skinny should not be treated as a verified calorie or health claim.
dietaryGuidance:
This beef burger is not suitable for vegetarians or vegans, and our data lists cereals containing gluten and sesame as allergens. No dietary suitability tags are recorded for this dish.

Anyone with coeliac disease, a gluten-related condition or a sesame allergy should check Wetherspoon's [allergen information](/allergen-information) and speak to the pub before ordering. Do not assume replacing chips with salad changes the listed allergens. If you request a swap or leave something out, ask staff to confirm how that affects the full dish and its preparation.

bestFor.title: Weekday lunch
bestFor.text: This suits a weekday lunch when you want a meaty burger with a fresh accompaniment. The dressed salad replaces the potato side without changing the beef patty.

bestFor.title: Salad over chips
bestFor.text: Choose this if you prefer a crisp, tangy side salad to chips. It keeps the soft bun and beef filling, rather than turning the meal into a bunless option.

bestFor.title: Classic burger fans
bestFor.text: Fans of the Classic beef burger get the same beef patty with a different accompaniment. That makes it a straightforward choice when the burger matters more than chips.

pairings.reason: Large Pepsi Max is an option if you want a drink alongside the burger. Ask whether it is eligible for a meal with a drink.
The Mini Warm Chocolate Brownie adds a warm chocolate finish after the savoury beef, if you want dessert rather than another side.
A Bowl of Chips lets you have both accompaniments, if you want the dressed salad but do not want to leave potatoes out.

tips: Confirm that you want the salad accompaniment when ordering, since this version replaces chips rather than removing the bun or changing the beef patty.
